newsitem.title: INDIA: OPINION - TECHNICAL ANALYSIS OF BSE INDEX, DEC 23-27.
newsitem.headline: OPINION - TECHNICAL ANALYSIS OF BSE INDEX, DEC 23-27.

text.p: The following technical analysis titled "BE ALERT FOR A
MINOR TOP FORMATION AT 3168 - 3218 LEVELS" is by Mehmood Khan of Times Guaranty Financial Ltd on the Bombay bourse's 30-share index for the period December 23-27, 1996:

Trading for the week ended on a buoyant note. With a gain of 229.04 points (7.95 percent) at 3110.19 levels over the previous week, a majority of the pivotals tracked after Friday's closing depicts that the rise on Friday has been on lower volume exhibiting that the rally is in its final stage and may lose momentum.

The weakness is reconfirmed by the speed of the rise @ 33.23 points per trading day as compared to the speed of the previous decline from 3035.64 to 2713.12 at the rate of 46.07 points per trading day.
The market commenced the week, on a strong note with bear covering, sensing the FII's commitments to close the year at 3100 plus levels to boost up their NAV's.

The domestic institutions participation in the game, has virtually helped the market to close upbeat with 229.04 points. If the BSE sensex manages to close on Tuesday between 3134-3195 levels, then we may be winding up 1996, with a net gain over the previous year (ie. 3110.49 as on December 22, 1995).

The interim rally from 2713.12, has retraced the decline of a larger degree from 3344.67 by 61.80 percent (3103.42). The cycle theory depicts the Change in trend (CIT) is due and may occur on 23rd/24th December 1996.

The sensex may encounter resistance at the left & right shoulders (3176 levels). As per the CIT, the rally may lose momentum at the 67 percent to 80 percent (i.e. 3134 - 3218). The mechanical oscillators in conjunction with the volume justify that the top may be formed at 3167.83 - 3193.10.

A classical head and shoulder pattern was formed by the sensex in the months of October - November 1996. The Left shoulder was at 3176.97 on Oct 11th, the Head was formed at 3344.67 on Oct 24th, and the Right shoulder at 3176.69 on Nov 11th,, was unable to surpass the Left Shoulder.

The Head and Shoulder pattern was confirmed after the sensex pierced the neck-line placed at 3033.26 (drawn by joining the Left & Right Shoulder bottoms) on Nov 22. As per the Head and Shoulder pattern, the decline after piercing the neck-line, forms the bottom between 80 to 100 percent of the height (vertical length from the Head to the neck-line) which in this case was 371.39 points.
The bottom at 2713.12 on Dec 4 was at 86.20 percent from the piercement of the neck-line.

Thus the interim upmove may be resisted at the shoulder at 3176 levels. The next immediate resistance is at the straight trendline drawn from the bottom of 3210.70 formed on March 26th. As per the time cycle theory, the sensex may move into the CIT time window on Monday.
Hopefully, an upday is formed on Monday. An upday is said to be formed when the sensex makes a higher high and a higher low with respect to the previous day's range of movement.

An upday formation on Monday would result in a clear three days trend running into the time zone. And if this were to happen then a minor top formation cannot be ruled out. The time cluster logic support the CIT date.

The greater the number of clusters terminating on the CIT date, the more powerful the turn date becomes. The present CIT date enjoys nine clusters which is reasonably high. Anything above eight clusters is considered high.The trend following indicators justify that the rally will loss momentum at the 200 weeks average at 3197.23.

The price following oscillators on the weekly bar chart are exhibiting that the top may be formed at 3168-3218 levels -Relative Strength Index (14 RSI) is 45.08,Price Rate Of Change (12 ROC) is placed at -4.44,short term stochastic is hovering at 48.76 and its trigger line is at 34.98, while the medium term stochastic is 21.16 and the trigger is 19.50, the Macd is - 144.38 and its trigger is -124.49 & the 14 William's percent R is placed at -44.67.
For the current week, the BSE sensex in the upmove may encounter resistance at 3167,3193, & 3218 levels, on the lower end it may find support at 3070-3042 levels.
The National Index may witness profit booking at 1385 - 1419 levels and support at 1354 & 1336 levels.
(The opinions expressed in this article reflect the views of the author only. They should not be taken as reflecting the views of Reuters).
